remarks: A Waterfront Estate That Lives Like a Private Resort. Few homes offer this rare blend of privacy, elegance, and waterfront access-just minutes from downtown Westport. Located at the end of a private lane in Westport's most sought after waterfront enclave, this estate is a haven for those who demand more from life. Wake to panoramic water views. Step outside to your own deep-water dock. Entertain on a grand scale with a sunlit patio, sparkling pool, and walled gardens. Indoors, vaulted ceilings, a glass-wrapped sunroom with fireplace, and seamless living spaces create an atmosphere of relaxed sophistication. Whether you're hosting a summer soiree, enjoying quiet evenings by the fire, or setting out by boat on a whim, this home gives you the freedom to live beautifully. Everything you need is here-and everything else is just minutes away. Live where others vacation. Own what few can.
